findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unbounded loop or operation without limits
 * @description Identifies loops or async operations without proper bounds that could lead to resource exhaustion
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unbounded-operation
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-400
 *       external/cwe/cwe-835
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from While w
where
  // Find while loops that don't have obvious termination conditions
  not exists(Compare cmp | 
    cmp.getScope() = w.getTest().getScope() and
    cmp.getASubExpression*() = w.getTest()
  ) and
  not exists(Call c |
    c.getScope() = w.getTest().getScope() and
    c.getASubExpression*() = w.getTest()
  )
select w, "While loop may not have proper termination condition, potentially leading to resource exhaustion"
findings.hypothesis: Check for potential DoS through unbounded loops or operations without timeout/limit controls that could lead to resource exhaustion

message.text: While loop may not have proper termination condition, potentially leading to resource exhaustion

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Socket operations without proper cleanup
 * @description Socket operations that may not be properly closed on error
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/socket-resource-leak
 * @tags security
 *        reliability
 *        resource-management
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("socket").getMember("socket").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("asyncio").getMember("open_connection").getACall()
  ) and
  not exists(With w | w.getContextExpr() = call.asExpr())
select call, "Socket operation may not be properly cleaned up on error"
findings.hypothesis: Socket operations that are not used in context managers may leak resources on error

message.text: Socket operation may not be properly cleaned up on error
